description: This file defines the CredentialRepository class, which handles database operations related to credential objects using SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting credentials.

classes.name: CredentialRepository
classes.description: Repository for credential persistence operations, encapsulating CRUD operations on Credential objects.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a database session.

methods.name: Credential create(self, owner_id: int, title: str, encrypted_blob: str)
methods.description: Creates a new credential record in the database with the given owner ID, title, and encrypted blob.

methods.name: Optional[Credential] get(self, cred_id: int, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a credential by its ID for a specific owner.

methods.name: List[Credential] list_for_owner(self, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all credentials for a specific owner, ordered by creation time in descending order.

methods.name: Credential update_blob(self, cred: Credential, encrypted_blob: str)
methods.description: Updates the encrypted blob of a given credential.

methods.name: None delete(self, cred: Credential)
methods.description: Deletes a specified credential from the database.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, owner_id: int, title: str, encrypted_blob: str) -> Credential:$/
ctags.signature: (self, owner_id: int, title: str, encrypted_blob: str)

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    def get(self, cred_id: int, owner_id: int) -> Optional[Credential]:$/

ctags.name: update_blob
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_blob(self, cred: Credential, encrypted_blob: str) -> Credential:$/
